main_issue: How the wake at the void deck can go ahead while accommodating A's mother's wheelchair access, B's evening sleep before night shifts, and C's morning exercise group.

A-B.evidence: A raised wheelchair access (T1) and B raised sleep (T4); they never addressed each other's positions.

A-C.evidence: A suggested the other lift lobby (T15) and C accepted it, 'that's a good idea' (T16).

A-D.evidence: D agreed to shift things for the wheelchair and asked A to show the space (T2); A thanked D (T3).

B-C.evidence: B and C raised separate concerns and never spoke to each other; C asked B for ideas (T14) but B did not reply.

B-D.evidence: D first held to the 10:30 end (T5) and B said that was the sleep window (T6); D then agreed to speak to family and point speakers away (T19, T24), and B said 'that should help a lot' (T25).

C-D.evidence: D said the space is occupied in the mornings (T8) and could not suggest an alternative (T13); C accepted without conflict (T14) and moved the group elsewhere.
